clips.title: The story
paras: Ula'elek has finished a pair of Brutal Gauntlets for a seasoned Horde warrior. Rare materials gathered across distant lands have gone into the work, meant to honor both maker and bearer.

Ula'elek brings his lineage and skill to the forging of armor for a seasoned frontline warrior. In Durotar, the Horde craftsman shapes brutal gauntlets from hardened trophies taken from dangerous foes. The finished armor is made to withstand fierce blows and strengthen the wearer's attacks.

For orcs and trolls, fine arms and armor carry the forge's prestige and the maker's spirit into battle. When Ula'elek presents the finished gauntlets, he entrusts a warrior with his ancestors' legacy. A champion who wears them is expected to meet that craft with courage, martial discipline, and strength.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. These gauntlets are my best work. Take them. In wearing them, you bring honor to me and my ancestors.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
